post.summary: Open a 120-second owner-authorized discovery window. Requires cookie and CSRF. Replaces unapproved requests.
Request connection during an open window; identical id/secret retries retain the request. Does not grant access until phone approval.

409.description: Window closed or request expired/reused

429.description: Rate limited or three pending requests already exist

get.summary: List only this owner's unapproved requests. Compare the label shown on the physical watch before approving.

post.summary: Explicitly approve matching physical watch. Requires owner cookie/CSRF. Idempotent; closes discovery and discards other unapproved requests.

200.description: Approved; the previously generated secret now authenticates this device

409.description: Request expired, foreign or device limit reached

post.summary: Poll with the persisted secret every two seconds. Approved requests remain recoverable after a lost response; revoked devices cannot reconnect this way.

200.description: Request state; expiresAt becomes the 90-day token expiry upon approval
